title: A decision is opened from the dashboard and bound to the nodes it holds
name: decision-open
description: Opening a decision is session and CLI only. DESIGN §2.6 says options are generated on demand by a model, and the dashboard has no model — so the brief must put to the user which of two this is: the human writes the question, category and bound nodes and the options come later from a session; or the human writes the options too, each with its reason and later cost. Either way: a route over the same core function with its test, a form on the decisions screen (apps/dashboard/src/decisions/), and the node is held from the moment it is bound. Delete open_decision from KNOWN_GAPS.
